column1: # Names the transliteration rules get wrong, and the spelling the shop uses.
# Consulted BEFORE the rules, always. A name here is never derived; it is looked
# up. This is where a correction lands when the operator fixes a PERSON_NAME cell
# in the review grid, so the file grows with use (ADR-035).
# Why it has to exist: English spelling does not mark vowel length, so the rules
# cannot know that `Menon` is മേനോൻ and not മെനൊൻ. No amount of rule-tuning
# fixes that — the information is simply not in the input.
# One token per line, lowercased, tab-separated:
# Lines starting with # are ignored. Keep it sorted.
# No trailing dot on these. Source punctuation is preserved exactly, so the
# operator's own `Dr.` supplies it — an entry of `ഡോ.` produced `ഡോ..`
